descriptionChirho: To let people go unbridled or leave them without restraint, resulting in wild or dissolute behavior (Qal active and Nifal passive/reflexive of the same core meaning).
To physically uncover, bare, or loosen something (especially hair or head), leaving it exposed or open.
To disregard, dismiss, or pay no attention to counsel, instruction, or wisdom, treating it as unimportant.
To deliberately stay away from or hold oneself back from something harmful or undesirable.
Causative stem meaning to cause someone to become unrestrained or to let them run wild by removing discipline or authority.
Causative stem meaning to cause people to desist or to hinder and distract them from a task or purpose.
